mapper.select: SELECT id FROM cps_withdraw_guard WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT user_id,balance,withdrawing_amount,status FROM sys_agent_commission_account WHERE user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM cps_withdrawal WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND request_key=#{requestKey}
SELECT * FROM cps_withdrawal WHERE withdraw_no=#{withdrawNo}
SELECT * FROM cps_withdrawal WHERE withdraw_no=#{withdrawNo} FOR UPDATE
SELECT config FROM cps_withdraw_policy WHERE id=1
SELECT config_value FROM sys_config WHERE config_key=#{key}
SELECT * FROM cps_withdraw_recipient WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND channel=#{channel}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cps_withdraw_recipient(user_id,channel,recipient_name,recipient_account,recipient_hash,verified,identity_verified,verification_ref,updated_by,updated_at) VALUES(#{userId},#{channel},#{recipientName},#{recipientAccount},#{recipientHash},#{verified},#{identityVerified},#{verificationRef},#{updatedBy},#{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE recipient_name=VALUES(recipient_name),recipient_account=VALUES(recipient_account), recipient_hash=VALUES(recipient_hash),verified=VALUES(verified),identity_verified=VALUES(identity_verified),verification_ref=VALUES(verification_ref), updated_by=VALUES(updated_by),updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT group_code FROM cps_withdraw_user_group WHERE user_id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cps_withdraw_user_group(user_id,group_code,updated_by,updated_at) VALUES(#{userId},#{group},#{operatorId},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE group_code=VALUES(group_code),updated_by=VALUES(updated_by),updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cps_withdrawal WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND created_at >=#{from} AND created_at <#{to}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cps_withdrawal WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='SUCCEEDED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cps_withdrawal WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id <#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cps_withdrawal WHERE recipient_hash=#{hash} AND created_at >=#{from} AND created_at <#{to}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM cps_withdrawal WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND created_at >=#{from} AND created_at <#{to} AND status NOT IN('FAILED','REJECTED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_order_commission WHERE buyer_user_id=#{userId} AND (line_status IN('RECEIVED','SETTLED') OR (line_status IS NULL AND settle_status='settled' AND order_status='settled'))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_order_commission WHERE buyer_user_id=#{userId} AND line_status='DISPUTED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_order_commission WHERE buyer_user_id=#{userId} AND (line_status='SETTLED' OR (line_status IS NULL AND settle_status='settled' AND order_status='settled'))

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=COUNT(commission_rate) THEN AVG(commission_rate) ELSE NULL END FROM (SELECT commission_rate FROM sys_order_commission WHERE buyer_user_id=#{userId} AND (line_status='SETTLED' OR (line_status IS NULL AND settle_status='settled' AND order_status='settled')) ORDER BY settle_time ASC,id ASC LIMIT 10) recent
SELECT * FROM cps_withdrawal ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cps_withdrawal
SELECT withdraw_no FROM cps_withdrawal WHERE id >#{afterId} AND status IN('SUBMITTING','PROCESSING','UNKNOWN','AWAITING_CONFIRMATION','TIMED_OUT') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM cps_withdrawal WHERE id >#{afterId} AND status='APPROVED' AND auto_pay_eligible=TRUE AND audit_by IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM cps_withdraw_mock_payment WHERE withdraw_no=#{withdrawNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cps_withdraw_mock_payment(withdraw_no,amount,recipient_hash,channel_no,status,callback_token,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{withdrawNo},#{amount},#{recipientHash},#{channelNo},#{status},#{callbackToken},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE withdraw_no=VALUES(withdraw_no)
mapper.update: UPDATE cps_withdraw_mock_payment SET status=#{status},updated_at=#{now} WHERE withdraw_no=#{withdrawNo} AND status NOT IN('SUCCESS','FAILED')
